localChanges: Ending your turn with the Adjust trade rates window open no longer closes it at once: it closes as the turn ends, so if the turn can't end yet (while talks are open, say), the window stays and Cancel still puts back the rates you started with (closes #1169).
When the game changes your trade rates itself while the window is open, as a change of government can, the window now shows the new rates, and Cancel no longer puts the old ones back over them.

A trade rate moved just as the game was being carried over to new art, or while your End Turn was being answered, is no longer lost if the game carries on: it's applied once it can be, and so is an OK or Cancel made meanwhile. Rates left that way are never applied to the next turn.
